name: Seerr Integration
description: Adds a Requests page to Jellyfin Web for discovering and requesting movies and series in Seerr. Every request is made as the signed-in Jellyfin user through Seerr Proxy. Requires the Seerr Proxy and JavaScript Injector plugins.
overview: Discover and request movies and series from Seerr inside Jellyfin
